metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Superman
metas.description: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way he soon finds himself in a world that views these as old-fashioned.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
metas.description: Hunt and the IMF pursue a dangerous AI called the Entity that's infiltrated global intelligence. With governments and a figure from his past in pursuit, Hunt races to stop it from forever changing the world.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: A world-renowned K-Pop girl group balance their lives in the spotlight with their secret identities as demon hunters.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: As an ancient threat endangers both Vikings and dragons alike on the isle of Berk, the friendship between Hiccup, an inventive Viking, and Toothless, a Night Fury dragon, becomes the key to both species forging a new future together.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
metas.description: A "Man From the Future" arrives at a diner in Los Angeles where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intel...

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Predator: Killer of Killers
metas.description: Three of the fiercest warriors in human history become prey to the ultimate killer of killers.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Sirat
metas.description: A father, accompanied by his son, goes looking for his missing daughter in the Moroccan desert. After a rave at which she might have been seen, the duo joins the party's proprietors on its way to its next gig in hopes of finding her.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Bad Guys 2
metas.description: The Bad Guys are struggling to find trust and acceptance in their newly minted lives as Good Guys, when they are pulled out of retirement and forced to do "one last job" by an all-female squad of criminals.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Ne Zha 2
metas.description: After a great catastrophe, the souls of Nezha and Aobing are saved, but their bodies face ruin. To give them new life, Taiyi Zhenren turns to the mystical seven-colored lotus in a daring bid to rebuild them and change their fate.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Swapped
metas.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
metas.description: The Soul Reapers and Quincies clash in a final battle as Yhwach breaches the Royal Palace. When the Soul King falls, reality begins collapsing. Former enemies unite to storm the transformed palace and face a threat to all existence. A theatrical screening of the first three episodes of the anime featuring an exclusive behind‑the‑scenes conversation with creator Tite Kubo, chief series director Tomohisa Taguchi, and series director Hikaru Murata about the production.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Jockey
metas.description: Rural action rooted in Madurai culture goat fighting tradition it blends fierce rivalries, raw emotions, trained animals, and authentic performances to capture the vibrant pulse of Tamil culture.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
metas.description: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Eko
metas.description: In misty Kaattukunnu hills, an elderly woman and her caretaker confront past memories while a hunted dog breeder named Kuriyachan eludes capture. As searchers arrive, buried secrets emerge.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · Wildwood
metas.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.
